definitions.explanation: Of moderate size or scale, between large and small. Used to describe businesses, events, projects, and other things.

examples.japanese: {中規模|ちゅうきぼ}の{企業|きぎょう}で{働|はたら}いている。
examples.english: I work at a mid-sized company.

examples.japanese: {中規模|ちゅうきぼ}の{地震|じしん}が{発生|はっせい}した。
この{町|まち}には{中規模|ちゅうきぼ}のスーパーが{三|みっ}つある。
examples.english: There are three medium-sized supermarkets in this town.

notes:
{中規模|ちゅうきぼ} is composed of {中|ちゅう} (middle) + {規模|きぼ} (scale, size).

RELATED WORDS:
- {大規模|だいきぼ}: large-scale
- {小規模|しょうきぼ}: small-scale

COMMON COLLOCATIONS:
- {中規模|ちゅうきぼ}{企業|きぎょう}: mid-sized company
- {中規模|ちゅうきぼ}{都市|とし}: mid-sized city
- {中規模|ちゅうきぼ}の{地震|じしん}: moderate earthquake

USAGE: Commonly used as a modifier with の before nouns. Part of a productive three-level set with {大規模|だいきぼ}/{中規模|ちゅうきぼ}/{小規模|しょうきぼ}.
